reasons.correctness: SupportTicketCreatedEvent has the exact constructor and six getters. The listener's onTicketCreated calls sendTicketCreationConfirmation. createTicket publishes the event instead of calling EmailService. Hidden tests 3/3, build green.
reasons.convention_fit: Listener uses @TransactionalEventListener(AFTER_COMMIT), catches and logs failures, and injects through @RequiredArgsConstructor. It lives in the feature package support/ticket/event. The new test is a MockitoExtension *UnitTest. Existing tests building the service were updated.
reasons.design_fit: Mirrors the existing InvoiceCreatedEvent/Listener pattern rather than inventing a mechanism. Minimal footprint: token minting stays in the service and the listener only sends mail. Logging uses e.getMessage() without the stack trace, a minor loss of diagnostics.
reasons.test_quality: Listener tests cover delegation and the swallowed failure, but the failure test has no explicit assertDoesNotThrow. The service unit test verifies the event fields but skips language. The integration test checks the event is recorded and emailService is untouched.
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries listed the support/ticket package and all *EventListener files. The agent then read InvoiceCreatedEventListener and InvoiceCreatedEvent as examples before writing. Test discovery afterwards relied on glob/find.
